name: waterlens
description: WaterLens monorepo — React frontend, FastAPI modular-monolith backend, shared contracts.

scripts.dev:api: cd services/backend && uv run uvicorn waterlens.api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.worker.main
scripts.seed: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.cli.seed
scripts.contracts: npm run contracts:export && npm run contracts:gen
scripts.contracts:export: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.api.export_openapi ../../packages/contracts/openapi.json
scripts.lint:py: cd services/backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm -w packages/contracts run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:py: cd services/backend && uv run mypy src
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:py
scripts.build: npm -w packages/contracts run build && npm -w apps/web run build
